pairs.target: lín zhào zhè yíyè xǐng le sānhuí .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao woke three times that night.
pairs.hanzi: 林照这一夜醒了三回。

pairs.target: tóuyìhuí shì jiān bèi suān , xiǎng fānshēn , bànshǎng méi fānguòqù .
pairs.english: The first time it was her aching shoulders and back; she wanted to turn over, but couldn't manage it for ages.
pairs.hanzi: 头一回是肩背酸，想翻身，半晌没翻过去。

pairs.target: dìèrhuí yǒurén huàngǎng , jiǎobù tíng zài ménnèi , dēngyǐng cóng yǎnpí shànghuàng guò .
pairs.english: The second time, someone changed watch; footsteps paused inside the door, and lamplight flickered over her eyelids.
pairs.hanzi: 第二回有人换岗，脚步停在门内，灯影从眼皮上晃过。

pairs.target: lún dào tā hé shào píngshí , láng wài hái hēi zhe ,
pairs.english: Her turn came with Shao Ping while it was still dark outside the gallery.
pairs.hanzi: 轮到她和邵平时，廊外还黑着，

pairs.target: tā bào xī zuòzài shímén hòu , tīng tā gé yízhèn biàn chūqù zǒu jǐbù , huílái yòng xiédǐ cèng diào shī ní .
pairs.english: She sat behind the stone door hugging her knees, listening as he went out for a few paces every so often, then on returning scraped away the wet mud from his soles.
pairs.hanzi: 她抱膝坐在石门后，听他隔一阵便出去走几步，回来用鞋底蹭掉湿泥。

pairs.target: " bié dīng zhe dēng . "
pairs.english: “Don't stare at the lamp,”
pairs.hanzi: “别盯着灯。”

pairs.target: tā dīshēng shuō , " yuè dīng yuè kùn . "
pairs.english: he said quietly. “The longer you stare, the sleepier you'll get.”
pairs.hanzi: 他低声说，“越盯越困。”

pairs.target: tā zhuǎnguò liǎn , wàng zhe ménwài nà kuài hēi .
pairs.english: She turned her face and looked at the patch of darkness outside the door.
pairs.hanzi: 她转过脸，望着门外那块黑。

pairs.target: méiguòduōjiǔ , lián hēiàn yě xiàng zài mànmàn huàngdòng .
pairs.english: Before long, even the darkness seemed to sway slowly.
pairs.hanzi: 没过多久，连黑暗也像在慢慢晃动。

pairs.target: huànxià shí tā āizhe pūgài zuò le yíhuìer , zài zhēngyǎn , ménwài yǐjīng fànbái le .
pairs.english: When relieved, she sat beside her bedding for a while; when she opened her eyes again, the doorway was already turning pale.
pairs.hanzi: 换下时她挨着铺盖坐了一会儿，再睁眼，门外已经泛白了。

pairs.target: tiānliàng shí , wēn shù jiào tā , dìyījù quèshì : " xié chuān fǎn le . "
pairs.english: At daybreak, Wen Shu woke her, but his first words were, “Your shoes are on the wrong feet.”
pairs.hanzi: 天亮时，温述叫她，第一句却是：“鞋穿反了。”

pairs.target: tā dītóu yí kàn , liǎngzhī xié yǐjīng chuān hǎo , bìng méiyǒu fǎn .
pairs.english: She looked down and saw both shoes already on, neither on the wrong foot.
pairs.hanzi: 她低头一看，两只鞋已经穿好，并没有反。

pairs.target: shào píng zài pángbiān xiào dé jiānbǎng zhí dǒu .
pairs.english: Shao Ping was beside her, laughing so hard his shoulders shook.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平在旁边笑得肩膀直抖。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng dèng tā , zìjǐ xiān xiào le , jiǎozhǐ suō zài hái cháo zhe de xiélǐ , yìshí yě bù juéde nàme lěng le .
pairs.english: She wanted to glare at him, but laughed first herself; her toes were curled inside the still-damp shoes, and for a moment she didn't feel quite so cold.
pairs.hanzi: 她想瞪他，自己先笑了，脚趾缩在还潮着的鞋里，一时也不觉得那么冷了。

pairs.target: chī guòzǎo shí , zhòngrén shōuqǐ pūgài .
pairs.english: After breakfast, everyone packed their bedding.
pairs.hanzi: 吃过早食，众人收起铺盖。

pairs.target: wēn shù xī le dēng , guàhuí bèináng cèbiān .
pairs.english: Wen Shu put out the lamp and hung it back on the side of his pack.
pairs.hanzi: 温述熄了灯，挂回背囊侧边。

pairs.target: lín zhào jiāng shèngxià nà kuài gān bǐng bāi le yíbàn , jiù shuǐ chīdiào , bǎ qìzhǐ chóngxīn tiēshēn shōu hǎo , yòu ná bùbāo zhù tóngguō yán .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao took the remaining flatbread, broke off half and ate it with water, tucked the contract back inside her clothes, and used the cloth to wrap the copper pot's rim again.
pairs.hanzi: 林照将剩下那块干饼掰了一半，就水吃掉，把契纸重新贴身收好，又拿布包住铜锅沿。

pairs.target: zuórì lè guò de dìfāng , yì yā jiù téng , tā bǎ bēidài wǎng wài nuó le nuó .
pairs.english: Where they had cut into her yesterday, it hurt at the slightest pressure; she shifted the straps farther out.
pairs.hanzi: 昨日勒过的地方，一压就疼，她把背带往外挪了挪。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu hé dùhéng cóng zhǎi jiē huílái , kùjiǎo dōu shī le .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou and Du Heng returned by the narrow steps, their trouser cuffs both wet.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟和杜衡从窄阶回来，裤脚都湿了。

pairs.target: " xiàmiàn xiān liú yíchù fàng dōngxī . "
pairs.english: “We'll leave a place below for the supplies first,”
pairs.hanzi: “下面先留一处放东西。”

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu shuō , " bù wǎng shuǐ lǐ bèi .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou said. “Don't carry them into the water.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟说，“不往水里背。

pairs.target: shào shīfu , nǐ dài tā gēn dào zhuàntái . "
pairs.english: Master Shao, you bring her as far as the landing.”
pairs.hanzi: 邵师傅，你带她跟到转台。”

pairs.target: nà dào jiē yánzhe láng xià de qiáng zhé le liǎngzhé .
pairs.english: The stairway turned twice along the wall beneath the gallery.
pairs.hanzi: 那道阶沿着廊下的墙折了两折。

pairs.target: lín zhào xià dào bàntú , cái fāxiàn zuóyè kànjiàn de jǐchù hēishí dǐng , yuánlái yǒugāoyǒudī ,
pairs.english: Only halfway down did Lin Zhao realize that the dark stone tops she had seen last night actually stood at different heights.
pairs.hanzi: 林照下到半途，才发现昨夜看见的几处黑石顶，原来有高有低，

pairs.target: jìn de yìpái lián zhe lùchū shuǐmiàn de shí biān , xiàng yìtiáo duànduànxùxù de lù .
pairs.english: The near row connected to a stone edge showing above the water, like fragments of a path.
pairs.hanzi: 近的一排连着露出水面的石边，像一条断断续续的路。

pairs.target: duàn gǒng lí jiē kǒu yǒu èr shíduōbù , dǐxià què hēi zhe , shuǐwén dào le nàlǐ biàn sàn le , kànbùqīng shēnqiǎn .
pairs.english: The broken arch stood twenty-odd paces from the foot of the stairs, but it was dark beneath; ripples reached it and scattered, hiding the depth.
pairs.hanzi: 断拱离阶口有二十多步，底下却黑着，水纹到了那里便散了，看不清深浅。

pairs.target: zhuàntái bǐ láng shàng zhǎi , zhī róng liǎngfù bèi jià kàoqiáng bìng páifàng .
pairs.english: The landing was narrower than the gallery, with just enough room for both pack frames side by side against the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 转台比廊上窄，只容两副背架靠墙并排放。

pairs.target: zhèngqiánfāng háiyǒu shí lái jí kuān jiē , mòwěi méi zài shuǐ lǐ ;
pairs.english: Directly ahead were a dozen or so more broad steps, their lower ends submerged in the water;
pairs.hanzi: 正前方还有十来级宽阶，末尾没在水里；

pairs.target: yòushǒu yídào shí yán tiēqiáng rào chūqù , tōngxiàng zuóyè nà zuò dī gǒng de shàngfāng .
pairs.english: to the right, a stone ledge ran out along the wall, leading toward the space above the low arch they had seen last night.
pairs.hanzi: 右手一道石沿贴墙绕出去，通向昨夜那座低拱的上方。

pairs.target: shào píng yòng jiǎo shìleshì , méi wǎng wài zǒu , xiān bǎ bèi jià fàngxià .
pairs.english: Shao Ping tested it with his foot, but didn't venture out; he set down his pack frame first.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平用脚试了试，没往外走，先把背架放下。

pairs.target: " dōngxī jiù liú zhèlǐ ? "
pairs.english: “The supplies just stay here?”
pairs.hanzi: “东西就留这里？”

pairs.target: lín zhào wèn .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao asked.
pairs.hanzi: 林照问。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu diǎntóu .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou nodded.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟点头。

pairs.target: " tīngjiàn jiào zài dì .
pairs.english: “When you hear a call, then pass things down.
pairs.hanzi: “听见叫再递。

pairs.target: yào tuì , xiān ràngchū jiē kǒu , bié qiǎng zhe bèi . "
pairs.english: If we retreat, clear the stairway first; don't rush to shoulder your loads.”
pairs.hanzi: 要退，先让出阶口，别抢着背。”

pairs.target: tā yìng le , jiěkāi zuì shàngmiàn nà quān shéng , cháo xià kàn le yìyǎn .
pairs.english: She answered and untied the top loop of rope, glancing down.
pairs.hanzi: 她应了，解开最上面那圈绳，朝下看了一眼。

pairs.target: wēn shù yǐ jiāng yàobāo dāndú līn chū , fàngzài liǎngfù bèi jià zhījiān .
pairs.english: Wen Shu had already taken out the medical bag and placed it separately between the two pack frames.
pairs.hanzi: 温述已将药包单独拎出，放在两副背架之间。

pairs.target: dùhéng cèshēn ràng tā guòqù , dùn shǐzhōng cháozhe tíngyuàn .
pairs.english: Du Heng turned sideways to let him pass, his shield facing the courtyard throughout.
pairs.hanzi: 杜衡侧身让他过去，盾始终朝着庭院。

pairs.target: xǔ cén dūn zài táijiē biān , dǎkāi mùxiá .
pairs.english: Xu Cen crouched beside the steps and opened the wooden case.
pairs.hanzi: 许岑蹲在台阶边，打开木匣。

pairs.target: nàgēn xì zhēn huàng dé bǐ chēshàng lìhài .
pairs.english: The fine needle wavered more violently than it had on the cart.
pairs.hanzi: 那根细针晃得比车上厉害。

pairs.target: tā jiāng xiázǐ fàngwěn , shǒuzhǎng lǒng zài yícè , děng le hǎo yíhuìer , cái xiàng shěn yàn zhōu yáotóu .
pairs.english: She steadied the case, cupped a hand beside it, and waited a long while before shaking her head at Shen Yanzhou.
pairs.hanzi: 她将匣子放稳，手掌拢在一侧，等了好一会儿，才向沈砚舟摇头。

pairs.target: " hái zài tóngyìn xiàn nèi .
pairs.english: “Still within the Bronze Seal line.
pairs.hanzi: “还在铜印线内。

pairs.target: dǐxià bǐ shàngmiàn mì . "
pairs.english: It's denser below than up here.”
pairs.hanzi: 底下比上面密。”

pairs.target: lín zhào bùyóudé wǎng shuǐ lǐ kàn , fǎngfú nàjùhuà néng ràng tā kànchū xiē shénme .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao couldn't help looking into the water, as though those words might let her make something out.
pairs.hanzi: 林照不由得往水里看，仿佛那句话能让她看出些什么。

pairs.target: shuǐmiàn yìngzhe huībái de tiān , chúle jǐgēn xì cǎo , shénme yě méiyǒu .
pairs.english: The surface reflected a gray-white sky; apart from a few blades of grass, there was nothing.
pairs.hanzi: 水面映着灰白的天，除了几根细草，什么也没有。

pairs.target: xǔ cén hégài de qīng xiǎng , què ràng tā juéde jiǎoxià zhè zuò zhuàntái yě báo le yìcéng .
pairs.english: Yet the soft click as Xu Cen shut the lid made her feel even the landing under her feet had lost a layer.
pairs.hanzi: 许岑合盖的轻响，却让她觉得脚下这座转台也薄了一层。

pairs.target: dùhéng wǎngxiàzǒu le sānbù , yòng chánggān tàn le tàn , yòu huàn le gè dìfāng .
pairs.english: Du Heng went down three steps, probed with a long pole, then tried a different spot.
pairs.hanzi: 杜衡往下走了三步，用长杆探了探，又换了个地方。

pairs.target: gāntóu yíchù pèng shí , yíchù méi xiàqù bànchǐ , dàishànglái hēisè de ruǎnní .
pairs.english: At one point the tip met stone; at another it sank half a foot, bringing up the soft black mud.
pairs.hanzi: 杆头一处碰石，一处没下去半尺，带上来黑色的软泥。

pairs.target: " yòubiān bié cǎi . "
pairs.english: “Don't step on the right.”
pairs.hanzi: “右边别踩。”

pairs.target: tā jiāng gān héng fàngzài nà liǎngjí shíjiē shàng .
pairs.english: He laid the pole crosswise on those two stone steps.
pairs.hanzi: 他将杆横放在那两级石阶上。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu gēnzhe xiàqù , qī lán yǐjīng dā hǎo jiàn , wēn shù liúzài èrrén hòufāng .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou followed him down; Qi Lan had already nocked an arrow, and Wen Shu stayed behind the two men.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟跟着下去，戚岚已经搭好箭，温述留在二人后方。

pairs.target: xǔ cén zài zhuàntái wàiyán àn xià yídào bái wén , cái yánzhe dùhéng tàn guò de dìfāng zǒu .
pairs.english: Xu Cen pressed a white mark onto the outer edge of the landing before walking along the ground Du Heng had tested.
pairs.hanzi: 许岑在转台外沿按下一道白纹，才沿着杜衡探过的地方走。

pairs.target: wǔgè rén xià dào shuǐbiān , lín zhào zhè cái tīngjiàn yuǎnchù lìng yìzhǒng shēngyīn .
pairs.english: Only when all five reached the water's edge did Lin Zhao hear another sound in the distance.
pairs.hanzi: 五个人下到水边，林照这才听见远处另一种声音。

pairs.target: yíxiàyixià , huǎnmàn dì guā zhe shítou .
pairs.english: Stroke by stroke, it slowly scraped at the stone.
pairs.hanzi: 一下一下，缓慢地刮着石头。

pairs.target: duàn gǒng páng chuí zhe de cū téng dòng le .
pairs.english: The thick vine hanging beside the broken arch moved.
pairs.hanzi: 断拱旁垂着的粗藤动了。

pairs.target: yípiàn huībái cóng téng hòu fānchūlái , lín zhào xiān yǐwéi shì kuài shíbǎn , zhídào tā dǐxià shēnchū jǐtiáo wānqū de tuǐ .
pairs.english: Something gray-white rolled out from behind the vine; Lin Zhao first took it for a stone slab, until several bent legs stretched out from its underside.
pairs.hanzi: 一片灰白从藤后翻出来，林照先以为是块石板，直到它底下伸出几条弯曲的腿。

pairs.target: nà dōngxī fú dé jí dī , bèishàng céngcéng yìngké qiàozhe biān ,
pairs.english: The creature crouched very low, its back covered in layers of hard shell with upturned edges.
pairs.hanzi: 那东西伏得极低，背上层层硬壳翘着边，

pairs.target: yǔshuǐ jī zài āochù , suízhe tā qǐshēn , yíxiàn yixiàn wǎng xià tǎng .
pairs.english: Rainwater had collected in the hollows; as it rose, the water trickled down in thin streams.
pairs.hanzi: 雨水积在凹处，随着它起身，一线一线往下淌。

pairs.target: tā bǐ zuórì nà liǎngzhī dàdéduō .
pairs.english: It was much bigger than the two from yesterday.
pairs.hanzi: 它比昨日那两只大得多。

pairs.target: qiánduān tiēzhe shuǐmiàn , liǎngtiáo xì xū tànchūqù , pèngdào fú cǎo biàn suōhuílái .
pairs.english: Its front end lay close to the surface; two slender feelers extended, then drew back on touching floating grass.
pairs.hanzi: 前端贴着水面，两条细须探出去，碰到浮草便缩回来。

pairs.target: lín zhào zhǎo le piànkè , yě méi zhǎodào yǎnjīng .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao searched for a moment, but couldn't find its eyes.
pairs.hanzi: 林照找了片刻，也没找到眼睛。

pairs.target: qī lán de gōng shāoshāo táiqǐ , shěn yàn zhōu què cháo tā bǎi le bǎishǒu .
pairs.english: Qi Lan raised her bow slightly, but Shen Yanzhou waved a hand at her.
pairs.hanzi: 戚岚的弓稍稍抬起，沈砚舟却朝她摆了摆手。

pairs.target: shuǐ lǐ yòu xiǎng le yìshēng .
pairs.english: Another sound came from the water.
pairs.hanzi: 水里又响了一声。

pairs.target: nà dōngxī shēnhòu háiyǒu liǎngdào zhǎi yǐng , ràoguò duàn zhù , zuānjìn le gǒng xià .
pairs.english: There were two more narrow shapes behind the creature; they rounded a broken pillar and slipped beneath the arch.
pairs.hanzi: 那东西身后还有两道窄影，绕过断柱，钻进了拱下。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu tuìhuí liǎngbù , shǒuzhǐ cháo hòu qīngqīng yì gōu .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou stepped back two paces, beckoning gently behind him with a finger.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟退回两步，手指朝后轻轻一勾。

pairs.target: dùhéng méi lìkè zhuǎnshēn , yíbù yibù dǎo zhe shànglái , zhídào wēn shù jiē zhù tā de xiǎobì , cái shōuhuí dùn .
pairs.english: Du Heng didn't turn immediately; he backed up one step at a time and only lowered the shield when Wen Shu took his forearm.
pairs.hanzi: 杜衡没立刻转身，一步一步倒着上来，直到温述接住他的小臂，才收回盾。

pairs.target: lín zhào píng zhe qì , děng nà céng yìngké chóngxīn fú dī le , cái fājué zìjǐ yìzhí niē zhe shéng tóu .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao held her breath until the shell settled again, then realized she had been gripping the rope end all along.
pairs.hanzi: 林照屏着气，等那层硬壳重新伏低了，才发觉自己一直捏着绳头。

pairs.target: xǔ cén huídào zhuàntái , jiāng tú pūkāi , bǔ le jǐbǐ .
pairs.english: Xu Cen returned to the landing, spread out the map and added a few strokes.
pairs.hanzi: 许岑回到转台，将图铺开，补了几笔。

pairs.target: qī lán zhǐ le zhǐ duàn gǒng zuǒcè .
pairs.english: Qi Lan pointed to the left side of the broken arch.
pairs.hanzi: 戚岚指了指断拱左侧。

pairs.target: " tā hòumiàn . "
pairs.english: “Behind it.”
pairs.hanzi: “它后面。”

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu huàn dào táijiē biān , bàn dūnxiàlái .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou moved to the edge of the stairs and crouched down.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟换到台阶边，半蹲下来。

pairs.target: lín zhào bùgǎn jǐguòqù , zhī cóng tā jiān cè wàng .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao didn't dare crowd closer, and only looked past his shoulder.
pairs.hanzi: 林照不敢挤过去，只从他肩侧望。

pairs.target: shuǐshàng de luàn téng zhē zhe shíbì , yìshí kànbùchū qī lán zài zhǐ shénme ;
pairs.english: Tangled vines above the water screened the stone wall; for a moment she couldn't tell what Qi Lan was pointing at.
pairs.hanzi: 水上的乱藤遮着石壁，一时看不出戚岚在指什么；

pairs.target: děng fēng jiāng yèzi xiānkāi , tā cái kànjiàn , yìdiǎn báiguāng xuán zài gǒng jiǎo de lièxì lǐ .
pairs.english: When the wind lifted the leaves, she finally saw a speck of white light suspended in a fissure at the foot of the arch.
pairs.hanzi: 等风将叶子掀开，她才看见，一点白光悬在拱脚的裂隙里。

alignment.english: at the foot of the arch

pairs.target: bìng bù hěn liàng .
pairs.english: It wasn't very bright.
pairs.hanzi: 并不很亮。

pairs.target: guāng lǐ yǒu jǐdào jí xì de xiàn , huǎnhuǎn dì xiàng lǐ shōu , shōu jìn le , yòu fǎngfú réng zài nàlǐ .
pairs.english: Within the light were a few exceedingly fine threads, drawing slowly inward; once drawn all the way in, they somehow still seemed to be there.
pairs.hanzi: 光里有几道极细的线，缓缓地向里收，收尽了，又仿佛仍在那里。

alignment.english: once drawn all the way in

pairs.target: tā zhǎ le zhǎyǎn , nà yìdiǎn biàn bèi yèzi zhēzhù le .
pairs.english: She blinked, and then the speck was hidden by the leaves.
pairs.hanzi: 她眨了眨眼，那一点便被叶子遮住了。

pairs.target: " jié zài lǐmiàn le . "
pairs.english: “It's formed a knot inside,”
pairs.hanzi: “结在里面了。”

pairs.target: xǔ cén shuō .
pairs.english: Xu Cen said.
pairs.hanzi: 许岑说。

pairs.target: lín zhào tīngdǒng le nàge " jié " zì .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao understood the word ‘knot.’
pairs.hanzi: 林照听懂了那个“结”字。

pairs.target: lái zhīqián fāng jǐn shuō guò , yào pò kāi kū lǐ de jié , cái suàn chéngshì .
pairs.english: Before they left, Fang Jin had told her they had to break the knot within the dungeon for the expedition to count as a success.
pairs.hanzi: 来之前方谨说过，要破开窟里的结，才算成事。

pairs.target: tā yuányǐwéi huì shì hěndà de yíkuài jīngshí , huòzhě xiàng chéngmén shàng nàyàng , kè zhe yìnwén de dōngxī .
pairs.english: She had imagined it would be a very large crystal, or something engraved with seal patterns like those on the city gate.
pairs.hanzi: 她原以为会是很大的一块晶石，或者像城门上那样，刻着印纹的东西。

pairs.target: fāngcái kànjiàn de , què xiàng yìgēn kuàiyào chuānguò zhēnyǎn de xiàn .
pairs.english: What she had seen just now, though, was like a thread about to pass through the eye of a needle.
pairs.hanzi: 方才看见的，却像一根快要穿过针眼的线。

pairs.target: tā hái xiǎng zài kàn , shào píng qīngqīng pèng le pèng tā de shǒuzhǒu , ràng tā jiāng shéng tóu lǐshùn .
pairs.english: She wanted another look, but Shao Ping touched her elbow lightly, prompting her to straighten the rope end.
pairs.hanzi: 她还想再看，邵平轻轻碰了碰她的手肘，让她将绳头理顺。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu ná guò tú , jiào zhòngrén wǎng nèi zhàn .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou took the map and asked everyone to move farther in.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟拿过图，叫众人往内站。

pairs.target: lín zhào ràng dào kàoqiáng chù , gé zhe tāmen de jiān , kànjiàn zuǒcè shíbì shàng yǒu yídào shēnsè shuǐ hén , bǐ yǎnxià de shuǐmiàn gāochū xǔduō .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao moved aside against the wall; looking past their shoulders, she saw there was a dark waterline on the left-hand stone wall, much higher than the present water surface.
pairs.hanzi: 林照让到靠墙处，隔着他们的肩，看见左侧石壁上有一道深色水痕，比眼下的水面高出许多。

pairs.target: qiánggēn xié zhe jǐkuài suìshí , shuǐ cóng fènglǐ shèn xiàlái .
pairs.english: Several broken stones leaned at its base, and water seeped down through the gaps.
pairs.hanzi: 墙根斜着几块碎石，水从缝里渗下来。

pairs.target: yòubiān dī gǒng qián , kūzhī jù chéng le yìtuán , hūér sànkāi yìdiǎn , yòu bèi shuǐ tuīhuíqù .
pairs.english: In front of the low arch on the right, dead branches had gathered into a clump; every so often they parted a little, only to be pushed back by the water.
pairs.hanzi: 右边低拱前，枯枝聚成了一团，忽而散开一点，又被水推回去。

pairs.target: " dùhéng xiān zhàn jìnchù nà pái shí biān . "
pairs.english: “Du Heng, take the near row of stone edges first,”
pairs.hanzi: “杜衡先占近处那排石边。”

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu yādī shēngyīn , " lán jiě kàn hòumiàn liǎngzhī , bié ràng tāmen rào huílái .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou said softly. “Sister Lan, watch the two behind it; don't let them get around us.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟压低声音，“岚姐看后面两只，别让它们绕回来。

pairs.target: xiān bǎ dà de yǐn lí duàn gǒng , bú zài téng dǐxià dǎ . "
pairs.english: Draw the big one away from the broken arch first; don't fight under the vines.”
pairs.hanzi: 先把大的引离断拱，不在藤底下打。”

pairs.target: wēn shù diǎntóu , jiāng xiùkǒu de jìdài yòu jǐn le yídào .
pairs.english: Wen Shu nodded and tightened his cuff ties another notch.
pairs.hanzi: 温述点头，将袖口的系带又紧了一道。

pairs.target: xǔ cén yòng zhǐjiǎ yāzhù tú shàng yìjiǎo , wèn le tuìhuí táijiē de zǒufǎ .
pairs.english: Xu Cen pinned a corner of the map with her fingernail, asking how they would get back to the steps.
pairs.hanzi: 许岑用指甲压住图上一角，问了退回台阶的走法。

pairs.target: jǐgè rén āizhe tú , yòu shuō le jǐjù .
pairs.english: Huddled around the map, they exchanged a few more words.
pairs.hanzi: 几个人挨着图，又说了几句。

pairs.target: lín zhào dītóu , bǎ liǎngfù bèi jià zhījiān de yàobāo wǎng wài nuó dào shēnshǒu jiù gòu dédào de dìfāng , shéngzi pánchéng quān , shéng tóu cháowài .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao lowered her head and moved the medical bag out from between the two pack frames to a spot within easy reach; she coiled the rope into loops with the rope end facing outward.
pairs.hanzi: 林照低头，把两副背架之间的药包往外挪到伸手就够得到的地方，绳子盘成圈，绳头朝外。

pairs.target: nà zhèn guā shí shēng yòu xiǎng qǐlái .
pairs.english: The scraping sounded again.
pairs.hanzi: 那阵刮石声又响起来。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu zài qù zhǎo nà yìdiǎn báiguāng , zhī kànzhe shuǐbiān lùchū de shítou , yíkuài yikuài , jìzhù nǎ kuài shì dùhéng gāngcái cǎi guò de .
pairs.english: She didn't search for the speck of white light again; she only watched the stones exposed at the water's edge, noting one by one which ones Du Heng had just stepped on.
pairs.hanzi: 她没有再去找那一点白光，只看着水边露出的石头，一块一块，记住哪块是杜衡刚才踩过的。
